**Needs changes before merge.**

Review tier: SAFETY. The PR changes the toolpath of 2D Adaptive (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/`).

## What looks good

- Auto keeps the old plan. `inside_without_holes_is_the_growth_plan_and_auto_ignores_the_stock` compares the Auto path with and without the stock outline. The digest writes `pass_start` only off Auto. The PR moves no golden.
- Each forced order that the HSM plan cannot honour falls back to Offset rings in the same order, and a note names the switch. No order is dropped without a word.
- The Trochoidal method refuses Inside and Outside by name at three places: `sane.rs` (command door), `generate.rs` (generator) and the UI consequence line.
- A tilted operation gets no stock outline (`generate.rs`, `frame.is_none()`), because the outline is in world XY.
- The project key is optional (`skip_serializing_if = "PassStartDto::is_auto"`). Old files load with no version step.
- New modules have provenance lines. The decision file `docs/decisions/3355-adaptive-pass-start.md` records the choices and the fig8 finding.

## Results

Built and tested locally on the PR head `addb167c2`. The trial merge with `upstream/main` conflicts (see item 1), so the merged tree was not built.

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion --lib machining2d::` | 259 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored |
| `camcraft-app --test adaptive_pass_start` | 4 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start` | 3 passed |
| `camcraft-app --lib` | 297 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test adaptive_trochoid` | 12 passed |

Not run (the machine was under a high load, and the time box ended): `camcraft-ui --lib` (the `pass_start` UI test), `roughing2d`, clippy. These are not a pass.

Mutations, re-run by the reviewer (each made red, then restored):

1. `pocket_hsm.rs`: the `air_only` guard off (`None if air_only && false`). Result: `outside_on_a_closed_pocket_rides_the_rings_from_its_wall_said` is red (`pocket_hsm_start_tests.rs:106`).
2. `pocket_hsm_start.rs`: the Inside-with-holes arm off (`PassStart::Inside if false && ...`). Result: `inside_with_holes_starts_on_the_part_wall_said` is red (`pocket_hsm_start_tests.rs:114`).

Goldens: the PR moves no golden file. Nothing to compare line by line.

Extra suites run: none were necessary. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code.

## Requested before merge

1. **The merge with main conflicts, and the conflict hides a warning.** `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm.rs:80-85` conflicts with #3035 on main. Main adds `RINGS_FALLBACK` (`" - Offset rings cut "`) and `rings_fallbacks()`. `generate.rs` on main uses `rings_fallbacks()` to raise `Warning::StrategyFallback` when an Adaptive area falls back to Offset rings.
   The two forced-order notes of this PR do not contain `" - Offset rings cut "`. They have `"; Offset rings cut ... in that order instead"`:
   - `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm.rs:83`
   - `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm_start.rs:65` (this hunk merges without a conflict, so the loss is silent)

   After a plain merge, an Outside or Inside fallback to rings gives a note but no `StrategyFallback` warning. Example: Outside on a closed pocket, or Inside with an island.
   Fix: when you merge main, write both forced-order notes with `RINGS_FALLBACK` and keep the `" instead"` end. Add a pin that `rings_fallbacks()` counts the note of an Outside closed pocket, or that the operation raises `StrategyFallback`.
2. **The stack base is old.** #3353 now has head `a91eb11d3` (two commits after `59b42c727`). This branch conflicts with that head in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs` and `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs`. Merge the new #3353 head into this branch (no rebase) and gate again.
3. **No screenshots.** The PR changes the UI: the "Pass starts at" row now shows on the 2D Adaptive Passes tab, with the Trochoidal consequence line (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/kind_editors.rs:71-75`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs`). Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. Put the images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch and link them. Do not commit them to this branch.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The diff against `main` includes `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, a process file. That change comes from the #3353 commit `59b42c727`. When #3353 merges first, this PR does not touch the file and needs no `Process change: yes` line. If this PR merges in a different order, it needs that line. The body also says "This session could not edit `.claude/skills/`". That text is correct for the #3355 commits only.
- `hsm_passes` under Outside refuses the full area when one later piece has no air side. All the area then goes to rings. This is safe. The decision file can say it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Main is merged into the branch. The new head is `b2b717162`.

## Conflict hunks

The earlier refresh left one conflict hunk in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm.rs`: the fallback note arms of `adaptive_ordered`. The resolution kept the branch's pass-start arms and routed each note through main's `RINGS_FALLBACK`. The merges of `ef1572114` and `6e641dac7` in this push were clean. They added no conflict hunk.

## WARN result

`pocket_hsm_start::rings()` now writes its note through `RINGS_FALLBACK`. On the fig8 Outside and Inside cases, the operation posts exactly one `StrategyFallback` warning and the "Pass starts at" note.

## Results

- `camcraft-app` `adaptive_pass_start` binary: the fig8 Outside and Inside pins pass. The MCP and undo test passes.
- `camcraft-motion` lib: the six `pocket_hsm_start` tests pass. The `pass_start` test passes.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean on the final head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 394 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled, on the `ef1572114` merge head.

## Fix in this refresh

`crates/app/tests/stock_play_cost_bench.rs` did not set the new `pass_start` field. `clippy --all-targets` found the error. The quick gate did not see it, because the gate builds only the targets that its diff picks. Commit `2e729de99` adds `pass_start: Default::default()`.

The heavy lanes did not run. "Not run" is not a pass.

The branch is ready for a re-check.

Re-check: the branch merges cleanly with `main` `6e641dac7`.

`git merge-tree --write-tree b2b717162 origin/main` gives exit 0 and no conflict. The PR reports `MERGEABLE` / `CLEAN`.

I removed the `conflicts` label.

The `needs-rework` label stays until an independent review reads the new head `b2b717162`.

Heavy lanes: not run. A review must run them before the PR is ready.

The merge of main `e313aa663` is DELTA: `pocket.rs` (4 hunks), `mod.rs` (re-export list) and `rest2d.rs` (1) conflict on the same logic, because #3353 replaced the pass-start API this branch builds on. The PR is a draft again with `needs-rework`. A worker resolves the merge on this branch; the new head then gets a fresh review. The earlier `merge-ready` at `b2b717162` does not carry over to that head.

Label maintenance: removed `needs-rework`. The collaborator review at head `b2b717162` (current head) says "Ready for the maintainer to merge". A clean review on the current head ends the change request (AGENTS.md "Only collaborators' reviews count"). The PR keeps `conflicts`: it does not merge with `main` until the parent #3353 merges and the branch takes `origin/main`.

**Needs changes before merge.**

Review tier: SAFETY. The PR changes the toolpath of 2D Adaptive and of 2D Offset (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/`).

This is a review of the new head `b2b717162`. The earlier review was on `addb167c2`.

## Status of the earlier findings

1. **The warning (finding 1): done.** `pocket_hsm.rs:83` and `pocket_hsm_start.rs:65` now write the note with `RINGS_FALLBACK` and end it with `instead`. `rings_fallbacks()` counts the note. The fig8 Outside and Inside pins in `adaptive_pass_start.rs` now require exactly one `StrategyFallback` warning (commit `2ee7e0f8b`).
2. **The stack base (finding 2): not done.** The branch never took the later #3353 commits. #3353 is now in `main`, and the PR conflicts with `main`. See blocker 1.
3. **Screenshots (finding 3): not done.** See blocker 2.

## What looks good

- Auto keeps the old plan. The digest writes `pass_start` only off Auto. The PR moves no golden.
- The Trochoidal method refuses Inside and Outside by name at the command door (`sane.rs`), in the generator (`generate.rs`) and in the UI.
- A tilted operation gets no stock outline (`generate.rs`, `frame.is_none()`).
- The MCP door keeps `auto` through the typed round-trip (`mcp/edit.rs`, `pass_start_kept`).
- The commit `2e729de99` fixes the `stock_play_cost_bench.rs` build error.

## Results

Built and tested locally on this machine. The trial merge with `upstream/main` (`6e641dac7`) is the PR head itself, because the PR already contains that main. `git merge` says "Already up to date".

| Gate step (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only ...`) | Result |
|---|---|
| `motion suites: lib` | 546 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored |
| `app suites: adaptive_pass_start` | 4 passed |
| `app suites: offset_pass_start` | 3 passed |
| `app suites: strategy_fallback` | 1 passed |
| `app suites: adaptive_trochoid` | 12 passed |
| `app suites: roughing2d` | 7 passed |
| `app suites: golden_cl` | 33 passed |
| `app suites: example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed |
| `ui suites: lib` | 1439 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored |

Not run, and not a pass:
- The full quick gate. The first full run stopped at the time limit of the session, because the host was under a high load from other reviews. I ran the steps above by name.
- Clippy. The author reports clippy clean on this head.
- The heavy lanes (see item 3).

Mutations, re-run by the reviewer on this head (each made red, then restored; the tree is clean after):

1. `pocket_hsm_start.rs:39`: the Inside-with-holes arm off (`PassStart::Inside if false && ...`). Result: `inside_with_holes_starts_on_the_part_wall_said` is red (`pocket_hsm_start_tests.rs:114`).
2. `generate.rs:840`: the generator's Trochoidal refusal off (`.filter(|_| false)`). Result: `trochoidal_adaptive_refuses_a_forced_pass_start_by_name` is red (`adaptive_pass_start.rs:176`).

Goldens moved: none. The PR changes no `*.cl`, `*.nc` or `examples/catalog/**` file. `golden_cl` and `example_catalog_adaptive` are green.

Extra suites run: none were necessary. The diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no import code.

## Requested before merge

1. **The branch carries an old #3353, with a known full-slot defect.** This blocks a merge.
   - The branch contains #3353 only up to `59b42c727`. It does not contain the three later #3353 commits: `9939a6238`, `a91eb11d3` and `3c3f13eb4`.
   - At `59b42c727`, the Inside and Outside ring order is `PassStart::rank` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/pass_start.rs:50-58`), used in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/waterscan.rs:134-143`.
   - The #3353 review of `59b42c727` (comment of 2026-11-22T10:31Z) found that this order cuts a full-width slot when a ring splits into pieces. The fig8 case has this shape. The author confirmed the defect, and #3353 replaced the order with level curves (`level_rings.rs`).
   - This PR uses that order for its own fallback: `pocket_hsm_start.rs` `rings()` and `pocket_hsm.rs:82-87` call `plan_passes_from(..., start)`. The fig8 Outside and Inside Adaptive pins take that rings fallback. Thus the fig8 Outside Adaptive path of this head can have full-width slots. The pins check only the first and the last move, so they do not see it.
   - #3353 merged into `main` at 2026-11-22T20:23Z, during this review. Now this PR conflicts with `main` (`5346bd7ac`) in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs`, `pocket.rs` and `rest2d.rs`. These are the files where #3353 replaced the ring order.
   - Fix: merge `origin/main` into this branch (no rebase). In the conflict, keep the new #3353 planner and its completeness guard. Route the Adaptive rings fallback (`pocket_hsm_start.rs` `rings()` and `pocket_hsm.rs:82-87`) through it. Do not keep `PassStart::rank`. Then run the pins, the quick gate and the reached heavy lanes again.
   - Add a pin that sees a full slot on the fig8 Outside Adaptive path (for example a check of the engagement of each pass, not only of the first and the last move).
2. **No screenshots.** The PR changes the UI: the 2D Adaptive Passes tab gets the "Pass starts at" row and the Trochoidal consequence line (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/kind_editors.rs`, `mill2d_page.rs`, `pass_start_row.rs`). Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. Put the images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch and link them. Do not commit them to this branch.
3. **Heavy lanes: not run on this head.** The body lists 8 heavy lanes from an older head. The NeoTech comment of 2026-11-22T19:05Z says that the heavy lanes did not run on `b2b717162`. A `motion` change reaches 243 heavy steps. Run them on the head that fixes item 1.

## Notes (not blocking)

- #3353 is now in `main`. After the merge of `main`, the `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` line is not in this diff, and no `Process change: yes` line is necessary.
- The body says "Stacked on #3353 (merge #3353 first)". Update this text after the merge of `main`.
- The body says that the full heavy run is "necessary before this PR is flagged ready". That is correct.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge of main `e313aa663` (the merge of #3353) resolved by hand. This is class DELTA, not SAME. The old review does not apply to this head.

**Resolution.** Main's `StartSide { start, stock, around_part }` is now the one pass-start input. The branch's `pocket_started_in` and `plan_passes_from` are removed.

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs`: `pocket_started` goes to `pocket_started_on`. `pocket_over_with_relief` takes `&StartSide`. The Adaptive arm calls `pocket_hsm_start::adaptive_passes_from`. Every other arm calls `level_rings::ring_plan`.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm_start.rs`: `adaptive_passes_from` takes the region and the `StartSide`. Each ring fallback is `ring_plan`, so the #3316 order and its completeness guard hold. Auto reads no stock. Auto is byte for byte unchanged.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm.rs`: `adaptive_ordered` takes the region and `around_part`. The Auto fallback is main's `plan_passes`.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm_start_tests.rs`: the motion pins call `pocket_started_on` with a `StartSide`.
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`: 2D Adaptive builds one stock source with `pass_start_stock::footprint` and calls `pocket_started_on`. The second API and the world-XY `air_stock` source are removed.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs` and `rest2d.rs`: main's API and exports.
- `crates/app/tests/adaptive_pass_start.rs`: one Inside pin changes. Main's ring law cuts each connected piece of the area on its own, with that piece's walls last. A level therefore ends on the last piece's last cut, not always on the stock edge. The pin now asserts the part-wall start and that the level cuts the stock edge in air on both sides. The other three pins are unchanged.
- `docs/decisions/3355-adaptive-pass-start.md`: the resolution and the pin change are recorded.

Both features stay. The #3316 Offset pass start and the #3355 Adaptive pass start both remain. No refusal, warning or stock rule is lost.

New head: `ddeda1259`. The PR needs a fresh review (class DELTA). The PR stays a draft.

Merge. Class: DELTA (the branch resolved two merges of `main` by hand: the adaptive feature re-expressed on main's `StartSide` API, and one append-both UI test). Review: pullrequestreview-6014643845 at `ddeda1259`. Heavy not run - owed to the cut (#3558). Nothing is pushed after this flag.

Coordinator: the merge route is the coordinator's. Another session merged this PR at 21:35Z, class DELTA, with no trial merge here. The PR changes the planning of 2D Adaptive toolpaths. The check of the tip 209f62665 follows (the adaptive, pocket, rough, face and pass-start suites of `motion` and `app`, the goldens, conformance, the example catalog suites, and the ui lib), and a read of the two hand resolutions.

Coordinator: read of the merged head ddeda1259 after the merge (read-only, not built). No code defect found. The check of the tip by a build is in progress.

- The default (Auto) path of 2D Adaptive is logically the same as before the PR. No golden moved.
- Each fallback to rings carries `RINGS_FALLBACK`, so the operation posts the `StrategyFallback` warning. Nothing falls back with no message.
- Trochoidal is refused by name at the command, in the generator and in the row of the page.
- An old project loads with Auto. `PROJECT_VERSION` stays 76.
- No new `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. The match on the start side has no wildcard arm.

Notes:
- The two commits that resolve the merges of `main` and the review of the final head come from the same account, five minutes apart. I cannot show that the review is independent. This read is the independent one.
- One pin became looser in the resolution, and the engagement pin that a reviewer asked for was not added: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3570.
- The MCP skill has no row for the Adaptive key: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3569.
- The body has no screenshots of the changed row (UI rule).
